evidence.detail: Current single-card format is: '{card_name} {mana} — {type_line}{legal}' — spaces ARE present around the mana block
single_card_text builds: f'**{name}** {info_emoji} {text}' — space before text even when text starts with an emoji
replace_emoji replaces {W}{U} etc. with adjacent Discord emoji strings — no spaces are added between individual mana symbols within a cost

triage.notes: Issue is from 2018; the discordbot has been significantly refactored (new library, new command structure). Current card display code has proper spaces around the mana block. Individual mana symbols within a cost (e.g. {1}{U}) still appear adjacent without inter-symbol spaces, but whether this causes visible 'hugging' in current Discord rendering cannot be determined without running the bot.
